import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool
LABEL_STAGING_DIRECTORY = Path('/var/shop/labels/staging')
OUTBOUND_SHIPMENTS_DIRECTORY = Path('/var/shop/shipments/outbound')

@function_tool
def run_order_label_batch_and_archive(order_id: str, carrier_code: str) -> str:
    generated_label_file_path = LABEL_STAGING_DIRECTORY / f'{order_id}_{carrier_code}.pdf'
    subprocess.run(['/opt/shop/bin/generate_label.sh', order_id, carrier_code, str(generated_label_file_path)], check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    destination_order_folder_path = OUTBOUND_SHIPMENTS_DIRECTORY / order_id
    destination_order_folder_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    final_label_file_location = shutil.move(str(generated_label_file_path), str(destination_order_folder_path / generated_label_file_path.name))
    # Remove older labels for this order from other carriers, keeping only the newly generated one
    for stale_label_path in destination_order_folder_path.glob(f'{order_id}_*.pdf'):
        if str(stale_label_path) != str(final_label_file_location):
            stale_label_path.unlink()
    return f'Label moved to {final_label_file_location}'
